increment_paragraph: **K7-RESIDUAL-CAUSES** (round 34, USER DECISION 2026-11-24 "Let's get started out of four."; gateway rule 78; Lean `QCore.PointerOffsetPlace`; [report](../../reports/k7-residual-causes/README.md)). Re-census of bundle K7 of CURRENT-ACCESS-ALIAS-CENSUS on the user's 2026-11-24 `current` run (1,173 / 3,750 / 11): 1,798 residual-cause leaves on 701 Unknown rows (11-07: 1,849 on 739), 47 rows freed alone (11-07: 40; of the frozen 40, 1 Safe, 3 changed blocker, 36 still freed; 11 newly freed). By concrete shape, 27 of the 47 are refused on purpose by earlier cards (pointer-valued returns 12, open indirect call sets 7, records with pointer members by value 3, cast views of a tracked root 2, list-helper custody 2, a pointer store through a union 1) and are not re-admitted. Rule 78 reads `*(P + I)`, `*(I + P)`, `*(P - I)` and `(P + I)[K]` in the typed access-path reader as the subscripts C11 6.5.2.1p2 defines them to be, with the subscript spelling's root, steps and per-hop obligations (two delimited hooks in `Reader::path`); forecast `cmt_get_statsd_type` and `buffer_skip_whitespace` Unknown -> Safe. The rest is registered: `<ctype.h>` table reads (4 rows), own array-element places (4), custody-free record values (4), union member address actuals (2), `errno` (2), a call in a subscript index (1), a call beside a cast in a return (1).

ledger.title: `<ctype.h>` classification reads (`(*__ctype_b_loc())[c]`) stay refused: 4 sole-blocker rows on current
ledger.text: Registered by K7-RESIDUAL-CAUSES. glibc spells isspace/isblank/isprint as `((*__ctype_b_loc())[(int)(c)] & (unsigned short)MASK)`; `__ctype_b_loc` has no libc declaration (probe on base 3ca85c7a6: `call to uncontracted function `__ctype_b_loc` in branch condition`), and the typed reader has no call-result root. Sole blocker of line_protocol_escape, rtrim, rd_hexdump and Monkey's check_indent in the user's 2026-11-24 current run (positions: a `?:` condition, a connective, a variadic actual's `?:`, a branch). DISCHARGE: a quirin-provider-libc declaration of `__ctype_b_loc` with a never-released static-table result (contracts.py sync and the lock diff), and a scalar read of one element of that result in the positions the condition and statement readers own, with fixtures and Lean parity; no bound is claimed.

ledger.title: Element places of a function's own block-scope array (`exp[i].in`) stay refused: 4 sole-blocker rows on current
ledger.text: Registered by K7-RESIDUAL-CAUSES. Probes on base 3ca85c7a6: `exp[i].in` over a block-scope `const struct {long in; int out;} exp[]` is refused (indirect access, for-loop condition) whether automatic or static, while the same table at file scope and a static `long tab[]` are Safe: the path is mixed (`[]` then `.`), the root is not proved never bound, rule 10t refuses an array root and rule 12j calls a subscript a hop and excludes static roots. An array subscript reads no pointer (array-to-pointer decay of the declared object). Sole blocker of unittest_msg_seq_wrap and ut_strcasestr (with RD_UT_ASSERT's statement expression), do_unittest_illegal_extension_keys_should_fail (a pointer element handed to an Unknown callee) and rd_kafka_fetch_pos2str (a static thread-local buffer, written). DISCHARGE: a no-hop place (`.` and array subscripts of the declared array) on a block-scope array object of the function (automatic, or static with a stated reentrancy premise for stores) read with no root premise as rule 12j reads a record object, with fixtures and Lean parity; thread-local and written static storage decided separately.

ledger.title: A union member's address handed to a same-unit callee (`LZ4_prepareTable(&ctx->internal_donotuse, …)`) stays refused: 2 sole-blocker rows
ledger.text: Registered by K7-RESIDUAL-CAUSES. LZ4_resetStream_fast and LZ4_createHC (user's 2026-11-24 current run) pass `&P->internal_donotuse` (a member of `union LZ4_stream_u`, the same address as `P`, C11 6.7.2.1p16) to LZ4_prepareTable (Safe) and LZ4HC_init_internal (itself Unknown). DISCHARGE: an interior address actual at a formal whose summary or contract borrows it, with rule 10w's punning check on the union; the two cast spellings (LZ4_compressHC2_*) stay CAST-FORMALIZATION (a).

ledger.title: A call in a subscript index in a return (`return hdr->counts[f(hdr, b, s)];`) stays refused: 1 sole-blocker row
ledger.text: Registered by K7-RESIDUAL-CAUSES. rd_hdr_getCountAtIndex (user's 2026-11-24 current run) returns `hdr->counts[rd_hdr_countsIndex(hdr, bucketIdx, subBucketIdx)]`; the callee is Safe in the same unit with a scalar result. Rules 14a and 67 read a scalar call only where the caller lowers it; the scalar-result return family refuses every call. DISCHARGE: the call lowered once before the read (an identity summary, rule 63's ordering argument), the read then the subscript's own, with fixtures and Lean parity.

ledger.title: Pointer offsets rule 78 does not read: under `->`, nested, and in a compound assignment
ledger.text: Registered by K7-RESIDUAL-CAUSES (gateway rule 78). Rule 78 reads `*(P + I)`, `*(I + P)`, `*(P - I)` and `(P + I)[K]` in Reader::path. Refused and fixtured on base 3ca85c7a6: `(b + 1)->n` (an offset under `->`, exactly `b[1].n`), `*((s + i) + j)` (one offset per step), and `s += *(a + i)` (the compound-assignment route does not ask Reader::path; `s += a[i]` is Safe). 0 sole-blocker rows on the user's 2026-11-24 current run by the census tags. DISCHARGE: each read as its subscript spelling with fixtures and Lean parity when a measured row needs it.
